# Chewy

> > Chewy is a comprehensive pet care resource offering product reviews, expert guides, and educational content across dog, cat, bird, and small animal care.

Chewy provides curated product recommendations, breed guides, nutrition advice, and behavioral training information for pet owners. The site features expert-reviewed content on pet health, safety, and wellness across multiple species, complemented by customer-reviewed product comparisons and buying guides.

## Key Topics

- Cat nutrition
- Dog grooming
- Pet health and safety
- Bird care
- Product reviews
- Breed guides
- Pet behavior
- Interactive toys
- Cat litter
- Cockatiel behavior
- Pet enrichment
- Buyer guides
- Product comparison
- Pet training
- Wellness guides

## Pet Education Hub

- [Chewy Education](https://www.chewy.com/education): Central hub for expert pet care advice on training, nutrition, and wellness.
- [Cat Care Tips, Guides, and Helpful Information | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat): Central hub for cat care tips, health guides, and feline wellness information.

## Cat Care & Nutrition

- [Cat Diet Guide: What Should I Feed My Cat? | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/food-and-nutrition/cat-nutrition): Complete cat nutrition guide covering life stages and AAFCO standards.
- [The Best Cat Bowls (Tried and Tested) | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/food-and-nutrition/best-cat-bowls): Tested cat bowl recommendations with product comparisons and reviews.
- [Maine Coon Breed: Characteristics, Care & Photos | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat-breeds/maine-coon): Maine Coon breed guide with characteristics, care tips, and temperament.
- [Lykoi (Werewolf) Cat Breed | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/general/behavior-breeds-meet-the-werewolf-cat-all-about-the-lykoi-breed): Lykoi breed guide covering rare genetic traits and care requirements.

## Bird Care & Behavior

- [Pet Bird Choking: Symptoms and Solutions | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/health-and-wellness/pet-bird-choking): Emergency care guide for recognizing and treating choking in pet birds.
- [Bird-Safe Cookware: What Pans Are Safe for Pet Birds? | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/health-and-wellness/bird-safe-cookware-is-there-a-killer-in-your-kitchen): Safety guide on bird-safe cookware to prevent Teflon poisoning risks.
- [5 Common Bird Beak Health Problems | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/health-and-wellness/5-common-bird-beak-health-problems): Guide to common bird beak health issues and veterinary care solutions.
- [Bird Body Language 101 | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/training-and-behavior/bird-body-language-101): Guide to decoding bird body language and communication with feathered pets.
- [What Causes Cockatiel Night Frights? | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/cockatiel/cockatiel-night-frights): Guide to understanding and preventing cockatiel night frights and anxiety.
- [Find Out Why Cockatiels Grind Their Beaks | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/cockatiel/why-do-cockatiels-grind-their-beaks): Educational guide explaining normal cockatiel beak grinding behavior.
- [Should Your Parrot Be On Your Shoulder? | Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/education/bird/general/should-your-parrot-be-on-your-shoulder): Parrot safety guide with tips on shoulder perching risks and training.
